mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shipment_records(order_id, merchant_shipment_no, carrier, tracking_number, status) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{merchantNo}, #{carrier}, #{tracking}, 'REQUESTED') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE carrier = VALUES(carrier), tracking_number = VALUES(tracking_number), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM shipment_records WHERE merchant_shipment_no = #{merchantNo} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE shipment_records SET platform_shipment_no = #{platformNo}, carrier = #{carrier}, tracking_number = #{tracking}, status = #{status}, shipped_at = COALESCE(shipped_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE shipment_records SET carrier = #{carrier}, tracking_number = #{tracking}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE order_id = #{orderId}

UPDATE shipment_records SET status = #{status}, delivered_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'DELIVERED' THEN COALESCE(delivered_at, #{occurredAt}) ELSE delivered_at END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, event_id, event_type, status, location, description, occurred_at FROM shipment_events WHERE shipment_id = #{shipmentId} ORDER BY occurred_at, id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shipment_notifications( shipment_id, notification_id, signature_valid, processing_status, payload_digest, failure_reason, processed_at ) VALUES ( #{shipmentId}, #{notificationId}, TRUE, #{processingStatus}, #{digest}, #{reason}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE shipment_records SET last_reconciled_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), reconciliation_error = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
